observations.behavior: Replaces static, connection-count-based group headers with a dynamic, action-aware expansion strategy; the 'Manage source' button is now shown when an action exists or status requires action, not just when status is 'Needs attention'.
observations.posthog_connection: This could support a dashboard UX where the Marketing Analytics source setup panel automatically expands groups with pending actions and provides a consistent 'Manage source' entry point, rather than relying on a single status value or a fixed first group. The implementation uses a shared expansion state and an action-aware helper, P1.F5.H9, P1.F5.H10, P1.F6.H1.
